talents.name: Retaliation
talents.description: With a shield equipped, a failed Block still grants Riposte, but its incoming-damage multiplier rises from 1.25 to 1.5.
talents.requirement: Shield equipped in accessory slot with a one-handed weapon.
talents.effect: Failed Block grants Riposte; incoming damage x1.5 instead of x1.25.

talents.name: Patient Shot
talents.description: A loaded ranged weapon's Attack that spends Opening consumes no ammunition.
talents.requirement: Loaded ranged weapon with enough ammunition for an ordinary attack; Opening active.

talents.name: Exploit Weakness
talents.description: The first successful weapon interrupt in a fight grants Opening for the next action.
talents.requirement: Disruption-family weapon vs Heavy move; interrupt cooldown ready.
talents.effect: First successful interrupt per fight grants Opening.

talents.name: Bloodlust
talents.description: Execution activates below 60% enemy HP instead of 40%, but attacks receiving that bonus lose 10 percentage points of accuracy.
talents.effect: Execution threshold 60%; -10 accuracy when the bonus applies.

talents.name: Sustained Pressure
talents.description: Weapon suppression also applies to the following enemy response. It refreshes rather than stacks.
talents.effect: Suppression carries to the next enemy response; refreshed, never stacked.

talents.name: Field Medicine
talents.description: The first healing item used in each fight preserves an existing Opening or Riposte.
talents.requirement: Healing consumable used in combat; Opening or Riposte active.
talents.effect: First combat heal per fight keeps Opening/Riposte; enemy still responds.
